description: The plot illustrates the "Massive Activation of baseline" by comparing the maximum activation values across different layers for four network components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 200. The blue dashed line represents "attn_output," which begins near 0 at layer 0, remains steady near 0 across most layers, and rises to approximately 250 at layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "attn_residual," starting near 0 at layer 0, remaining low until layer 5, then spiking to roughly 1400 at layer 6; it climbs to about 1580 by layer 14, maintains a steady plateau until layer 20, and sharply declines from approximately 1550 at layer 22 to 250 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line represents "ffn_output," which starts near 0 at layer 0, exhibits a sharp peak of roughly 1380 at layer 5, and drops back near 0 at layer 6. It shows subsequent peaks of approximately 950 at layer 13 and 1180 at layer 22, ending at roughly 550 at layer 23, while remaining near 0 between these peaks. Finally, the red solid line represents "ffn_residual," beginning near 0 at layer 0, staying low until layer 4, and spiking to roughly 1400 at layer 5. It plateaus around 1480 between layers 7 and 12, rises to a higher plateau of approximately 1580 between layers 14 and 20, drops sharply to roughly 390 at layer 22, and ends at approximately 620 at layer 23.
